a: John Owen (1616–1683) yali omunnyonnyozi w'enjigiriza asookera ddala mu Bapuritani ab'e Bungereza — omusumba wa Oliver Cromwell, Ddiini wa Christ Church era Omumyuka wa Cansala wa Yunivasite y'e Oxford, era oluvannyuma lwa 1662 omuweereza Omunkukunala eyagaaniddwa okuyingira mu yunivasite ze yali akulembedde. Yatiikirira olw'obuzito bw'ebiwandiiko bye n'olw'okutegeera okutuukirira okw'enjawulo engeri ekibi gye kikolera ku muntu, era y'ensonga lwaki ekitabo kye ekitono eky'okutta ekibi kiwangadde okusinga kumpi byonna ebirala ebyawandiikibwa mu kyasa kye ku nsonga eyo.

Yazaalibwa mu 1616 mu Stadhampton mu Oxfordshire, mutabani w'omuweereza wa Katonda Omupuritani, n'agenda mu Queen's College, Oxford, nga wa myaka nga kkumi n'ebiri, era n'aggya diguli ye nga wa myaka kkumi na mukaaga, ng'asoma n'obukakkamu obungi obwamukkirizanga okwebaka essaawa nnya zokka buli kiro — empisa gye yeenenya oluvannyuma ng'obubbi ku bulamu bwe. Mu 1637 teyayinza mu mwoyo gwe okugondera amateeka amaggya ag'ekkanisa aga Ssabalabirizi Laud, n'ava mu yunivasite mu kifo ky'okugonda, ne kimuggyako essuubi lye.

Newankubadde ng'ayize ennyo, Owen yamala obuvubuka bwe mu kizikiza ky'omwoyo ekiwanvu era eky'amaanyi: yakkiriza Enjiri naye teyasobola kuwulira nti ya bubwe, era yabuusabuusa oba nga yali akyusiddwa n'akatono. Nga mu 1642 yagenda okuwulira omubuulizi ayatiikirivu Edmund Calamy, ataajja; mu kifo kye omuweereza wa Katonda ow'omu byalo atamanyiddwa n'abuulira ku kigambo nti "Mmwe abalina okukkiriza okutono! Lwaki mutya bwe mutyo?" — era wansi w'okubuulira okwo okwangu, okuva mu mubuulizi Owen gwe yatasobola oluvannyuma kuzuula linnya lye, obukakafu bwe yali asabye ne bujja ku nkomerero.

Ekkalaamu ye yamumanyisa; yabuulira mu maaso ga Palamenti Empanvu, era olunaku olwaddirira okutemebwako omutwe kwa Charles I n'abuulira mu maaso gaayo nate, eyo gye yasisinkana Cromwell. Cromwell yamutwala ng'omusumba w'eggye e Ireland n'e Scotland, n'amufuula Ddiini wa Christ Church, Oxford, mu 1651 era Ssabawandiisi Omumyuka owa yunivasite yonna omwaka ogwaddirira — bw'atyo omulenzi eyava mu Oxford olw'empisa n'agifuga, ng'akyusa era ng'akuuma abayivu ab'enjuyi zonna.

q: The Mortification of Sin kye ki?
a: Kyafulumizibwa mu 1656 ng'okunnyonnyola olunyiriri lumu olw'Abaruumi, era kikyali ekitabo ekyatiikirivu eky'Ekikristaayo ku lutalo olwa buli lunaku era olw'obugenderevu ku kibi ekibeera munda, era sentensi yaakyo esinga okujulizibwa bye by'omwoyo byonna mu kussa omukka gumu: "Tta ekibi; kifuule omulimu gwo ogwa buli lunaku; beera nakyo bulijjo ng'okyali mulamu; tolekaayo lunaku lumu ku mulimu guno; beera ng'otta ekibi, oba kijja kukutta."

q: Of Communion with God kye ki?
a: Singa The Mortification of Sin eraga obukambwe bwa Owen, munnaayo ow'omu 1657 eraga obuwoomi bwe. Kigamba nti omukkiriza afuna obumu obwa nnamaddala, obw'enjawulo, era obulabikako ne buli Muntu wa Katonda Asatu — ne Kitaawe mu kwagala kwe, n'Omwana mu kisa kye, n'Omwoyo mu kubudaabuda kwe. "Nga bwe tulaba okwagala kwa Katonda," bwe yawandiika, "bwe tutyo bwe tunaasanyukira mu ye, so si okusingawo." Omusajja ajjukirwa ng'ennyondo eri ekibi yali, mu kifo kye eky'okusoma, asinga okwemalira mu kusanyukira Katonda.

Ku kudda kw'Obwakabaka mu 1660 Owen yafiirwa obuddiini, era Etteeka ery'Obumu mu 1662 ne limugoba ye n'abaweereza abalala nga enkumi bbiri okuva mu Kkanisa ya Bungereza kyokka. Mu bulamu bwe obwasigalawo yali Munkukunala — ng'abuulira ebibiina ebyakuŋŋaananga mu bulabe era ng'awandiika awatakoowa ku kugumiikiriza, ng'agaaniddwa embuulira n'eyunivasite gye yali akulembedde. Yafuuka omukulembeze era omuwolereza akkirizibwa ow'Obwetwaze, era wadde nga ebiwango byajja, nga mw'otwalidde n'ekimu okuva e Boston, n'asigala okulunda ekisibo ekiyigganyizibwa eky'ewaka.

q: Omukwano gwe ne Bunyan gwali gutya?
a: Owen yassaamu ekitiibwa okubuulira kwa John Bunyan, omuddaabiriza w'entamu ow'e Bedford eyasibibwa, era kigambibwa mu ngeri ekakasa nti yakozesa ekifo kye ku lubiri okuyamba okuggya Bunyan mu kkomera. Charles II bwe yeewuunya nti omusawo omuyivu bw'atyo yandivudde mu London okuwulira omuddaabiriza w'entamu atayize, Owen bagamba nti yaddamu nti yandiwaddeyo n'essanyu obuyivu bwe bwonna olw'amaanyi g'omuddaabiriza oyo ku kituuti — ebigambo ebituufu bituutuukako kokka nga biyita mu buwangwa obwaddirira, naye obwetoowaze obubirimu bwe bubwe ddala.

Bwamusasuza nnyo. Yawasa Mary Rooke era mu ye n'azaala, nga bawandiisi b'ebyafaayo bye bwe bagamba, abaana nga kkumi n'omu — bonna okuggyako omu baafa nga bakyali bato, era muwala omu yekka eyatuuka mu bukulu n'akomawo eka oluvannyuma lw'obufumbo obutali bwa ssanyu n'afa amangu akafuba. Mary yennyini yafa mu 1675. Omusajja eyawandiika n'obwegendereza obungi ku ngeri ennaku gye ewanirira abakkiriza yali aziise kumpi ab'omu maka ge bonna, era ennaku eyo ewa ebiwandiiko bye ku kubonaabona n'obukakafu obuzito bw'ekintu ekyasasulirwa.

Owen yafa nga 24 Agusito 1683 e Ealing. Ennaku bbiri nga tannafa, ng'awandiisa ebbaluwa ey'okusiibula eri mukwano gwe ow'edda Charles Fleetwood, yawandiika nti: "Ngenda eri Oyo emmeeme yange gwe yayagala, oba okusingawo, oyo eyanjagala n'okwagala okutaggwaawo, kwe musingi gw'okusanyusibwa kwange kwonna." Bwe baamutegeeza ku makya ge ag'enkomerero nti ekitabo kye Meditations on the Glory of Christ kyali kigenze mu kuddukanya, yaddamu nti "olunaku olwasuubirwa ennyo lutuuse ekyenkomerero." Yaziikibwa e Bunhill Fields mu Beeyawuzi be yali ayagadde.
